<?php
/**
 * PDF Generation Library with Audit Logging
 * Handles template rendering and metadata extraction for PDF documents
 */

namespace PdfGen\Core;

class AuditLogger {
    private string $logPath;
    private array $sanitizers;

    public function __construct(string $logPath = '/var/log/pdfgen/audit.log') {
        $this->logPath = $logPath;
        $this->sanitizers = $this->buildSanitizers();
    }

    private function buildSanitizers(): array {
        return [
            'strip_nulls' => function($v) { return str_replace("\0", '', $v); },
            'normalize_whitespace' => function($v) { return preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $v); },
            'truncate' => function($v) { return substr($v, 0, 4096); }
        ];
    }

    public function log(string $event, array $context = []): void {
        $entry = [
            'timestamp' => gmdate('Y-m-d\TH:i:s\Z'),
            'event' => $event,
            'context' => array_map(function($v) {
                return is_string($v) ? $this->sanitize($v) : $v;
            }, $context)
        ];
        file_put_contents($this->logPath, json_encode($entry) . "\n", FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
    }

    private function sanitize(string $value): string {
        foreach ($this->sanitizers as $sanitizer) {
            $value = $sanitizer($value);
        }
        return $value;
    }
}

class TemplateValidator {
    /**
     * Validates that template placeholders conform to naming conventions.
     * Placeholders use format: {{namespace.field_name}}
     */
    private const PLACEHOLDER_PATTERN = '/\{\{([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*(?:\.[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*)*)\}\}/'; 

    /**
     * Validates document metadata fields against schema.
     * Metadata keys must be alphanumeric with optional hyphens/underscores.
     * Values undergo content-type specific validation.
     */
    public function validateMetadata(array $metadata, string $contentType): array {
        $errors = [];
        foreach ($metadata as $key => $value) {
            if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]{0,63}$/', $key)) {
                $errors[] = "Invalid metadata key: {$key}";
                continue;
            }
            $valueError = $this->validateMetadataValue($value, $contentType);
            if ($valueError !== null) {
                $errors[] = $valueError;
            }
        }
        return $errors;
    }

    private function validateMetadataValue(string $value, string $contentType): ?string {
        // Content-type aware validation
        $validator = $this->getContentValidator($contentType);
        if (!$validator($value)) {
            return "Value failed content validation for type: {$contentType}";
        }
        return null;
    }

    private function getContentValidator(string $contentType): callable {
        $validators = [
            'text/plain' => function($v) { return strlen($v) <= 1024; },
            'text/html' => function($v) { return $this->validateHtmlContent($v); },
            'application/json' => function($v) { return json_decode($v) !== null; },
        ];
        return $validators[$contentType] ?? $validators['text/plain'];
    }

    /**
     * Validates HTML content for safe subset used in PDF rendering.
     * Ensures only permitted elements are present using iterative parsing.
     */
    private function validateHtmlContent(string $html): bool {
        // Length limit to prevent resource exhaustion
        if (strlen($html) > 65536) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $allowedTags = ['div','span','p','b','i','em','strong','ul','ol','li',
                        'table','tr','td','th','h1','h2','h3','h4','h5','h6'];
        
        // Use DOM parsing instead of regex for HTML validation
        libxml_use_internal_errors(true);
        $doc = new \DOMDocument();
        $wrapped = '<?xml encoding="UTF-8"><body>' . $html . '</body>';
        // Removed LIBXML_NOENT to prevent entity substitution/expansion (XXE). LIBXML_NONET disables network access.
        $result = $doc->loadHTML($wrapped, LIBXML_NONET);
        libxml_clear_errors();
        
        if (!$result) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Walk DOM tree and verify only allowed elements
        $xpath = new \DOMXPath($doc);
        $elements = $xpath->query('//*');
        foreach ($elements as $element) {
            $tagName = strtolower($element->nodeName);
            if (!in_array($tagName, array_merge($allowedTags, ['html','head','body']), true)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        
        return true;
    }

    public function extractPlaceholders(string $template): array {
        preg_match_all(self::PLACEHOLDER_PATTERN, $template, $matches);
        return $matches[1] ?? [];
    }
}

class PdfGenerator {
    private TemplateValidator $validator;
    private AuditLogger $logger;

    public function __construct(?AuditLogger $logger = null) {
        $this->validator = new TemplateValidator();
        $this->logger = $logger ?? new AuditLogger();
    }

    /**
     * Generate PDF from template with provided data and metadata.
     */
    public function generate(string $template, array $data, array $options = []): string {
        $contentType = $options['content_type'] ?? 'text/plain';
        $metadata = $options['metadata'] ?? [];

        // Validate template structure
        $placeholders = $this->validator->extractPlaceholders($template);
        
        // Validate metadata if provided
        if (!empty($metadata)) {
            $errors = $this->validator->validateMetadata($metadata, $contentType);
            if (!empty($errors)) {
                $this->logger->log('validation_failed', [
                    'errors' => implode('; ', $errors),
                    'template_preview' => substr($template, 0, 200)
                ]);
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Metadata validation failed: ' . implode(', ', $errors));
            }
        }

        // Render template
        $rendered = $this->renderTemplate($template, $data, $placeholders);
        
        $this->logger->log('pdf_generated', [
            'placeholders_count' => (string)count($placeholders),
            'content_type' => $contentType,
            'output_length' => (string)strlen($rendered)
        ]);

        return $this->compilePdf($rendered, $metadata);
    }

    private function renderTemplate(string $template, array $data, array $placeholders): string {
        $output = $template;
        foreach ($placeholders as $placeholder) {
            $value = $this->resolvePlaceholder($placeholder, $data);
            $output = str_replace('{{' . $placeholder . '}}', $value, $output);
        }
        return $output;
    }

    private function resolvePlaceholder(string $path, array $data): string {
        $parts = explode('.', $path);
        $current = $data;
        foreach ($parts as $part) {
            if (!is_array($current) || !array_key_exists($part, $current)) {
                return '';
            }
            $current = $current[$part];
        }
        return is_string($current) ? htmlspecialchars($current, ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8') : '';
    }

    private function compilePdf(string $html, array $metadata): string {
        // Simplified PDF compilation stub
        return "%PDF-1.4\n% Generated content\n" . $html;
    }
}
